description: NoteBox: adding and searching notes work; pinning does nothing and an empty title is not refused.

claims.text: Add a note with a title and see it in the list
Type in the search box and the list narrows to the matching notes
Pin a note so it moves to the top of the list with a Pinned label
Adding a note with an empty title shows a clear message and adds nothing

controls.text: Export the notes as a PDF file
